description.en: Recognition and management of intraprocedural bleeding, capnoperitoneum, mucosal injury, and full-thickness perforation during POEM.

criteria.en: Requires prompting to execute; recognises the need for intraprocedural adverse-event management but cannot yet perform reliably.
Performs intraprocedural adverse-event management independently to source-defined standards.
Teaches intraprocedural adverse-event management to trainees; handles atypical/complex cases.

provenance.reason: Atomic-skill decomposition of the source-canonical ESGE POEM 2025 Part II recommendations into trainee-assessable units. The POEM curriculum enumerates recommendations and the PPAT scores procedures; this competency frame is Evideris's design for portfolio-level tracking.
